meta.title: Virtual pet
meta.description: Runs Codex-format pet packs inside DSH, reading ~/.dsh/pets first and falling back to ~/.codex/pets.

setting.title: Virtual pet
setting.hint: The pet switch at the sidebar foot; shortcut ⌥Space.
setting.source.codex: ~/.dsh/pets has no usable pet, so ~/.codex/pets is used
setting.empty: No pet pack found: drop a folder with pet.json and a spritesheet into ~/.dsh/pets.
